```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Overview

(A) Spatial distribution of Niche 8 (N8) spots projected onto representative tissue sections at Day 0, 1, 3, 5, 7, and 28 post-infection.
(B) DotPlot of differentiation and proliferation marker genes in N8 spots, grouped by timepoint.
(C) UMAP of urothelial cells split into resting (URO) and activated/inflammatory (aURO) populations, with (D) the proportion of each across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi). 
(E) DotPlot of canonical urothelial differentiation and proliferation markers across timepoints and URO/aURO populations.
(F) PROGENy pathway activity heatmap comparing URO vs aURO.
(G) PROGENy pathway activity heatmap of N8 spots across timepoints.
(H) Heatmap of antimicrobial peptide and stress-response gene expression in URO vs aURO.
(I) Heatmap of antimicrobial peptide gene expression in N8 across timepoints.
(J) DotPlot of inflammatory cytokine and chemokine expression in in URO vs aURO.
(K) DotPlot of inflammatory cytokine and chemokine expression in N8 across timepoints.
(L) GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for URO- and aURO-specific DEGs.

Input:  
  Spatial transcriptomics: Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds
  Urothelium Single cells: PIPSeq_UROAnn_v061824.rds

Output: Results/Figures/Figure3/

## Shared setup

```{r shared-setup}
# Six representative sections, one per timepoint
selected_slices  <- c("slice1", "slice3", "slice4", "slice7", "slice8", "slice9")
timepoint_labels <- c("Day 0", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 5", "Day 7", "Day 28")
names(timepoint_labels) <- selected_slices

pt_size_map <- c(
  slice1 = 1800, slice3 = 1800, slice4 = 1600,
  slice7 = 1600, slice8 = 1800, slice9 = 1800
)

# All N8 spot barcodes across the entire object
n8_cells <- WhichCells(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = "N8")
cat("Total N8 spots:", length(n8_cells), "\n")
```

## Figure 3A: Spatial location of N8 across timepoints

```{r fig3a-spatial, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
fig3a_panels <- lapply(selected_slices, function(sl) {
  pt_sz <- if (sl %in% names(pt_size_map)) pt_size_map[[sl]] else 1800
  SpatialDimPlot(
    Pyelonephritis_Infection,
    images          = sl,
    cells.highlight = n8_cells,
    cols.highlight  = c("yellow", NA),  # N8 = yellow, others = invisible
    pt.size.factor  = pt_sz,
    crop            = TRUE,
    label           = FALSE
  ) +
    ggtitle(timepoint_labels[sl]) +
    coord_cartesian() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
})

Fig3aSpatial <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = fig3a_panels, nrow = 1)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3A_N8_SpatialLocation.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3aSpatial,
  width    = 20,
  height   = 4
)

Fig3aSpatial
```

## Figure 3B: N8 differentiation and proliferation markers by timepoint

```{r fig3b-dotplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Subset to N8 spots only
N8_obj <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, idents = "N8")

N8_obj@meta.data %>% head()
# Set identity to timepoint (orig.ident expected to encode DPI, e.g. "0DPI", "1DPI")
# Verify: table(N8_obj@meta.data$orig.ident)
Idents(N8_obj) <- N8_obj@meta.data$orig.ident

# Reorder identities from earliest to latest timepoint
timepoint_order <- c("PyeloD0_1", "PyeloD1_2", "PyeloD3_1", "PyeloD5_2", "PyeloD7_1", "PyeloD28_1")
timepoint_order <- timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% levels(factor(Idents(N8_obj)))]
Idents(N8_obj)  <- factor(Idents(N8_obj), levels = timepoint_order)

# Urothelial differentiation hierarchy: basal → intermediate → superficial
proliferation_markers   <- c("Mki67", "Top2a", "Pcna", "Ccna2", "Cdk1", "Cdc20")
differentiation_markers <- c(
  # Basal / progenitor (least differentiated)
  "Krt5", "Krt14", "Tp63", "Cd44",
  # Intermediate
  "Krt7", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Krt19",
  # Superficial / umbrella cells (fully differentiated)
  "Upk1a", "Upk1b", "Upk2", "Upk3a", "Upk3b",
  # Transcription factors driving urothelial differentiation
  "Foxa1", "Gata3", "Pparg",
  # Tight junction / barrier function
  "Cldn3", "Cldn4", "Cldn7"
)
markers_all <- c(proliferation_markers, differentiation_markers)

DefaultAssay(N8_obj) <- "SCT"

Fig3bDotPlot <- DotPlot(
  N8_obj,
  features = markers_all,
  cols     = c("lightgrey", "#E31A1C"),
  dot.scale = 6
) +
  #coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(
    title = "N8 differentiation and proliferation markers by timepoint",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colorbar(title = "AveExp"),
    size   = guide_legend(title  = "PerExp")
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3B_N8_DotPlot_Timepoints.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3bDotPlot,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 4
)
```

## Figure 3G: PROGENy pathway activity in N8 across timepoints
```{r fig3g-progeny, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Use the pathwaysmlm assay already computed in Figure 1F / Figure 3B session
Idents(N8_obj)
# Average scaled pathway activity per timepoint
df_n8 <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(N8_obj, assay = "pathwaysmlm",
                                   layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(timepoint = Idents(N8_obj)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -timepoint, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(timepoint, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

# Wide matrix: rows = timepoints, cols = pathways; transpose for heatmap
n8_acts_mat <- df_n8 %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "timepoint", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("timepoint") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Order pathways and timepoints
PathwayOrder <- c(
  # Inflammatory signaling
  "TNFa", "NFkB", "JAK-STAT",
  # Cell death / stress
  "Trail", "p53", "Hypoxia",
  # Developmental / morphogenic
  "TGFb", "WNT",  "Estrogen",
    # Growth factor / proliferation
  "EGFR", "MAPK", "PI3K", "VEGF"
)
PathwayOrder <- PathwayOrder[PathwayOrder %in% colnames(n8_acts_mat)]

N8HeatmapMat <- t(n8_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder, timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% rownames(n8_acts_mat)]]

# Symmetric color scale centered on 0
palette_length <- 100
my_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig3GProgenyHeatmap <- pheatmap(
  N8HeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 8,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  color          = my_color,
  breaks         = my_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy pathway activity – N8 across timepoints",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3G_N8_PROGENy_Timepoints.pdf"), width = 4, height = 5)
print(Fig3GProgenyHeatmap)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 3C: UMAP of URO vs aURO and proportion across timepoints

```{r fig3c-umap-proportion, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
# UMAP coloured by URO annotation
Fig3C_UMAP <- DimPlot(
  UROcells,
  label      = TRUE,
  repel      = TRUE,
  split.by  = "DataSet",
  pt.size    = 0.5
) +
  labs(title = "Urothelial cell populations") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Stacked bar: proportion of URO / aURO at each timepoint
prop_df <- table(UROcells@meta.data$DataSet, UROcells@meta.data$UROAnnotation) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, Population = Var2) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order_sc))

Fig3C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = Population)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("URO" = "#4393C3", "aURO" = "#D6604D")) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion", title = "URO / aURO proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

Fig3C <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig3C_UMAP, Fig3C_Prop, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(3, 1.5))

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3C_URO_aURO_UMAP_Proportion.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3C,
  width    = 8, height = 4
)
Fig3C
```

## Figure 3C-PROGENy: Pathway activity heatmap comparing URO vs aURO

```{r fig3c-progeny-heatmap, fig.width=4, fig.height=5}
# Reset identity to URO annotation for pathway scoring
Idents(UROcells) <- factor(UROcells@meta.data$UROAnnotation, levels = c("URO", "aURO"))
DefaultAssay(UROcells) <- "RNA"

net_uro <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = "mouse", top = 500)
mat_uro <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(UROcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"))

acts_uro <- run_mlm(
  mat     = mat_uro,
  net     = net_uro,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "weight",
  minsize = 5
)

UROcells[["pathwaysmlm_uro"]] <- acts_uro %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "source", names_from = "condition", values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

DefaultAssay(UROcells) <- "pathwaysmlm_uro"
UROcells <- ScaleData(UROcells)

df_uro <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(UROcells, assay = "pathwaysmlm_uro", layer = "scale.data"))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(cluster = Idents(UROcells)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cluster, names_to = "source", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(cluster, source) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

uro_acts_mat <- df_uro %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "cluster", names_from = "source", values_from = "mean") %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

PathwayOrder_uro <- c(
  "TNFa", "NFkB", "JAK-STAT",
  "Trail", "p53", "Hypoxia",
  "EGFR", "MAPK", "PI3K", "VEGF",
  "WNT", "TGFb", "Estrogen"
)
PathwayOrder_uro <- PathwayOrder_uro[PathwayOrder_uro %in% colnames(uro_acts_mat)]

UROHeatmapMat <- t(uro_acts_mat)[PathwayOrder_uro, c("URO", "aURO")]

palette_length <- 100
uro_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(palette_length)
uro_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0,   length.out = ceiling(palette_length / 2) + 1),
                seq(0.05, 2, length.out = floor(palette_length / 2)))

Fig3F_Progeny <- pheatmap(
  UROHeatmapMat,
  fontsize       = 8,
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = TRUE,
  color          = uro_color,
  breaks         = uro_breaks,
  main           = "PROGENy – URO vs aURO",
  angle_col      = 45,
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 0
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3F_URO_aURO_PROGENy_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 3, height = 5)
print(Fig3F_Progeny)
dev.off()
```

```{r fig3h-amp-heatmap, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
Idents(UROcells) <- factor(UROcells@meta.data$UROAnnotation, levels = c("URO", "aURO"))
DefaultAssay(UROcells) <- "RNA"

amp_genes <- c("Camp","Defa1","Defa2","Defb1","Defb2","Defb3","Defb4","Defb14","Defb24","Reg3g","Reg3b","S100a7","S100a8","S100a9","Ltf","Lyz1","Ctsg","Ctsb","Lcn2","Pi3","Hamp","Sftpa1","Sftpd","Pla2g2a","Mpo","Elane","Hist1h2aa","Hist1h2bb","Rnase2","Rnase4","Umod", "Mbd1", "Mbd2","Ear2", "Ear11", "Ear6")
# Keep only genes present in the object
amp_genes <- amp_genes[amp_genes %in% rownames(UROcells)]

# I want to use the Doheatmap
Fig3H_AMPDoheatmap<-DoHeatmap(
  UROcells,
  features  = amp_genes,
  assay     = "RNA",
  slot      = "data",
  disp.min  = 0,
  disp.max  = 4
) +
  # scale_fill_gradientn(
  #   colours = c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"),
  #   limits  = c(0, 4),
  #   na.value = "white"
  # ) +
  #labs(title = "AMP – URO vs aURO") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# save the figure
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3H_URO_aURO_AMP_DoHeatmap.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3H_AMPDoheatmap,
  width    = 6, height = 7
)

# Average expression per population
avg_mat <- AverageExpression(UROcells, features = amp_genes, assays = "SCT", layer = "data")$SCT
avg_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(as.matrix(avg_mat))))

amp_color  <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "firebrick3"))(100)
amp_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0, length.out = 51), seq(0.05, 2, length.out = 50))

Fig3H_AMP <- pheatmap(
  avg_mat_scaled,
  fontsize       = 8,
  fontsize_row   = 7,
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,
  cluster_rows   = TRUE,
  color          = amp_color,
  breaks         = amp_breaks,
  main           = "AMP & stress-response genes – URO vs aURO",
  border_color   = NA,
  treeheight_col = 0,
  treeheight_row = 10
)

pdf(file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3H_URO_aURO_AMP_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 3.5, height = 7)
print(Fig3H_AMP)
dev.off()
```

## Figure 3L: GO Biological Process enrichment dotplot for URO- and aURO-specific DEGs

```{r fig3l-go-enrichment, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
Idents(UROcells) <- factor(UROcells@meta.data$UROAnnotation, levels = c("URO", "aURO"))
DefaultAssay(UROcells) <- "SCT"

AllMarkers_uro <- FindAllMarkers(
  UROcells,
  min.pct   = 0.25,
  #logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use  = "MAST",
  only.pos  = TRUE
)

write.csv(
  AllMarkers_uro,
  file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3M_URO_aURO_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ClusterGenes <- list(
  URO  = AllMarkers_uro %>% filter(cluster == "URO", p_val_adj <=0.05 & avg_log2FC>=0.25) %>%  pull(gene),
  aURO = AllMarkers_uro %>% filter(cluster == "aURO", p_val_adj <=0.05 & avg_log2FC>=0.25 ) %>% pull(gene)
)

GO_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = ClusterGenes,
  fun          = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb        = "org.Mm.eg.db",
  ont          = "BP",
  keyType      = "SYMBOL",
  pvalueCutoff = 1
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(GO_compare),
  file = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3M_URO_aURO_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Select GO terms relevant to the figure description
selected_go <- c(
  "antimicrobial humoral response",
  "defense response to bacterium",
  "neutrophil recruitment",
  "neutrophil activation",
  "granulocyte migration",
  "inflammatory response",
  "chemokine production",
  "response to lipopolysaccharide",
  "regulation of inflammatory response",
  "innate immune response",
  "cytokine production",
  "response to wounding",
"cellular respiration","response to hypoxia","NADP metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide catabolic process","reactive oxygen species metabolic process","hydrogen peroxide metabolic process","generation of precursor metabolites and energy","fatty acid metabolic process","organic acid catabolic process","carboxylic acid catabolic process","regulation of cellular pH","intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway"
)


Fig3L_GO <- dotplot(
  GO_compare,
  showCategory = selected_go,
  font.size    = 10,
  label_format = 60,
  by           = "geneRatio"
) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process – URO vs aURO DEGs") +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(Outdir, "Figure3L_URO_aURO_GO_Dotplot.pdf"),
  plot     = Fig3L_GO,
  width    = 9, height = 4.5
)
Fig3L_GO
```

```{r fig3j-cytokine-chemokine-dotplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
Idents(UROcells) <- factor(UROcells@meta.data$UROAnnotation, levels = c("URO", "aURO"))
DefaultAssay(UROcells) <- "RNA"

chemokines_sc <- c(
  "Ccl2", "Ccl3", "Ccl4", "Ccl5", "Ccl7", "Ccl9", "Ccl20",
  "Cxcl1", "Cxcl2", "Cxcl3", "Cxcl5", "Cxcl9", "Cxcl10", "Cxcl12",
  "Cxcl13", "Cxcl16", "Cx3cl1"
)

cytokines_sc <- c(
  "Il1a", "Il1b", "Il6", "Il10", "Il12a", "Il12b",
  "Il17a", "Il17f", "Il18", "Il23a", "Il33",
  "Tnf", "Ifng", "Csf2", "Csf3",
  "Tgfb1", "Vegfa"
)

# Keep only genes present in the object
chemokines_sc <- chemokines_sc[chemokines_sc %in% rownames(UROcells)]
cytokines_sc  <- cytokines_sc[cytokines_sc   %in% rownames(UROcells)]

Fig3J_DotPlot <- DotPlot(

  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),

ggsave(

)
```
